subject: reasoning
question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in two lines, facing the north. Three persons are sitting in each line. F is sitting in the middle. C is just behind B. D is to the immediate right of E. B is to the immediate left of F. Which three persons are sitting in the same line?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• **Six friends** - A, B, C, D, E and F
 
• **They are sitting in two lines, facing the north. **
 
• **Three persons are sitting in each line.**

**​Explanation:**

1) F is sitting in the middle

There are two possibilities of the position of F i.e F is sitting either in row - (1) or in row - (2).

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22087a665d41281b5bbdd888eef8c639ce143c1d7729a0d768d96692123ae279.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5e64753fe80e9f385b9f08ba7859febac80a2ab3a6a9e93c684070793279a99.png] ​

2) B is to the immediate left of F.

3) C is just behind B.

As C is just behind B, therefore C will be sitting in row - (2)

As B cannot be position in row -(1) therefore, case - (2) will be eliminated.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/572e90bedcbcf748c38133ca9de75725817ea49de7bfa4c428ec7ae293a76a04.png] ​

4) D is to the immediate right of E.

After positioning D and E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e A.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d20d0d011cae881b031f3930924e5b7e6a343298db12468ff1ec881411ae7b8b.png] ​

Thus, according to the final arrangement 'B, F and A' and 'C, E and D' are sitting in row -(1) and row - (2) respectively.

Hence, **"****C, D and E"** is the correct answer.
